zh: 黑格尔重新构造之前的辩证法
想必这是一个广为人知的事实：在古希腊，术语“辩证法”（dialektikē）指的是亚里士多德在《修辞学》
中所说的正确思维的“艺术”，它应当是科学或哲学探究的先决条件和必然特征。
任何可能导致真实或准确结论的考察——用亚里士多德的话说，即“逻辑的”或“三段论的”结论——
任何能够自称哲学的真理追求，都基于我们今天所称的逻辑前提。亚里士多德会称之为辩证法——“logikē”一词直到古代晚期才出现，而且即便出现，其含义也仍不同于现代用法。在《修辞学》中，亚里士多德特意把诡辩意义上的良好论证——因此未必由“对智慧的热爱”驱动——与真正的辩证论证区分开。后者关乎价值，更确切地说，关乎伦理学；前者则关乎准确论证本身作为一种技艺或艺术——亚里士多德会称之为technē——
这种能力任何个体都能掌握，而不必是职业哲学家（或古希腊的等同者）。

of correct thinking, one that ought to be the prerequisite and the inevitable characteristic of scientific or philosophical inquiry.
Any examination of a matter that could lead to a truthful or accurate conclusion, a ‘logical one’ (or ‘syllogical’) as Aristotle would put it,
any pursuit of truth that could call itself philosophical, operates on the premises of what we would nowadays call logic. Aristotle would have called it
does not appear until late antiquity, and when it does, it is still not in the sense we use the word in our era of modernity. In

zh: 在本章中，我们将尝试重建辩证法作为本体论范畴在欧洲哲学舞台上的出现。似乎我们在共产主义学说“diamat”中所见的唯物辩证法，其起源可以追溯到黑格尔，但并不完全源于马克思本人。这似乎有悖直觉，或与我们所受的教育以及在马克思主义、马克思本人著作及其思想遗产方面习惯性的思维方式背道而驰。然而，若仔细审视马克思关于唯物主义与辩证法这一双重主题的著作——既把它视为统一体，也把它视为两个独立范畴——就会发现，他对辩证法的处理始终更接近古代人，而非黑格尔。
en: In this chapter, we will attempt to reconstruct the appearance of dialectics as an ontological category on the scene of European philosophy. It seems that the origins of materialist dialectics as we find it in the communist doctrine of Diamat can be traced back to Hegel but not quite to Marx himself. This may seem counterintuitive, or as something that goes against everything we have been taught and have gotten used to thinking on the matter regarding Marxism and Marx’s own body of work and legacy. Nonetheless, a closer look at Marx’s writings on the dual topic of materialism and dialectics, seen as a unity as well as two separate categories, will show us that his treatment of dialectics has always been closer to that of the Ancients than to that of Hegel.

zh: 我们必须注意他的博士论文中的一个微小例外：其中我们可以发现一种推理方式，在某种（且值得商榷的）程度上与黑格尔式辩证法模式相似；而他基于原子论的唯物主义，则与受黑格尔启发的“diamat”逻辑相矛盾。马克思对古希腊原子论的解读，塑造了他毫不妥协的唯物主义立场，我们将在本章后文更深入探讨。在此只需指出，根据青年马克思，支撑伊壁鸠鲁原子论的矛盾，是定义原子物质属性的特性与作为原子概念规定的形式之间的产物。然而，后者并不构成更高的真理形式，也不是存在的目的（causa finalis）。它无非是物质现象的概念——原子，始终已经具象化，从未被赋予理想性，也从未参与任何更宏大且包罗万象的观念。
因此，理想性并非观念，而是物质的完美形式；若以属性来表述这种形式，必然偏离理想形式——或者简而言之，正如马克思所言，偏离概念本身。概念虽从具体中抽象出来，却并不存在于“理想性”领域，也无法栖居于物质性之外的任何其他宇宙——因为根本不存在这样的世界。
en: We must note a slight exception to this rule in his doctoral thesis, in which we can detect a form of reasoning that operates to a certain (and arguable) degree similarly to the Hegelian model of dialectics, whereas his materialism grounded in the atomist theory contradicts the logic of the Hegel-inspired Diamat. Marx’s reading of Greek atomism informs his uncompromisingly materialist stance, something we will inspect more closely further on in the chapter. At this point, suffice it to say that the contradiction that underpins Epicurean atomism, according to young Marx, is the product of the properties that define an atom materially and the form that is the atom’s conceptual determination. The latter, however, does not constitute a higher form of truth or purpose of existence,

. It is nothing that would go beyond quite simply being the concept of a material phenomenon – the atom, always already embodied and never endowed with an ideality or participation in a greater and all-encompassing idea.

Ideality is thus not an idea but a perfect form of the material whose predication in terms of property is necessarily an aberration from the ideal form – or simply the concept, as Marx puts it. The concept is abstracted from the concrete but does not reside in a realm of ideality, and it cannot inhabit any other universe but that of materiality – because there is no such world.

zh: 因此，我们将把唯物主义和辩证法这两个范畴视为彼此区分、相互处于单边关系之中

，摒弃马克思主义思想传统中——无论是“科学”的（马克思主义）还是哲学层面的——对二者统一性的教条式预设。马克思将引导我们回溯到古希腊原子论——更确切地说，是伊壁鸠鲁及其著名的伊壁鸠鲁学派代表卢克莱修·卡鲁斯——去探寻唯物主义的科学起源，或者说，探寻那种更接近科学探究方式而非哲学—神学探究方式的唯物主义的起源。在此之前，让我们重新审视古希腊时期的辩证法问题，以及它演变为黑格尔对该术语理解的可能路径。
en: We will, therefore, look at the two categories, materialism and dialectics, as distinct and unilateral to one another,

without the canonically presumed unity of the two when it comes to the Marxist tradition of thought, be it ‘scientific’ (Marxism) or philosophy. Marx will lead us retrospectively to look for the scientific origins of materialism – or for the origins of the materialism that is closer to a scientific mode of inquiry than to a philosophical-theological one – in Greek atomism, more specifically that of Epicurus and the famous Epicurean Lucretius Carus. Before we do so, let us revisit the question of dialectics in Greek antiquity and the possible routes of its evolution to the Hegelian understanding of the term.

zh: Dialektikē、认知的机械性与物质性

children: Dialektikê, mechanicity and materiality of cognition

zh: 在接触关于希腊“辩证法”概念的文献学与哲学讨论时——尤其是亚里士多德著作中所使用的这一概念——人们往往会感到困惑。希腊城邦中典型的“辩论”实践，或者更确切地说，那种公开论战的文化，怎么会与“逻辑”（即配得上“哲学”这一属性、或当今所称“科学”的思维艺术）混为一谈呢？然而，我们认为这并非混淆，而是通过对辩证交流实践规则的抽象——或者说，通过对准确思考或符合对真理一贯追求的思维规律的抽象——对这种被观察到的实践进行形式化。因此，类似于马克思对“原子概念”——或其形式——的处理，亚里士多德抽象出了我们今天所称的逻辑思维的理想形式。这仿佛是把观察到的物质现实的“模具”从其基础中抽离出来，并通过运用辩证思维的“艺术”，将其形象（或形式）进一步形式化为一个“概念”（如同马克思的原子概念），这与维特根斯坦在《逻辑哲学论》中提出的Maßstab（尺度）极为相似。

正如亚里士多德在《物理学》（214a12–214a16）中所论述的，概念是“正确思维方式”的产物，亦即下文将通过对亚里士多德《修辞学》相关段落的细读所探讨的辩证或三段论式的思维方式。这门艺术的精髓在于能够辨别“真实的三段论”——即属于辩证法（dialektikē）的三段论——与属于修辞学的虚幻三段论：ὥσπερ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς διαλεκτικῆς συλλογισμόν τε καὶ φαινόμενον συλλογισμόν（引自亚里士多德《修辞学》1:1）
，或译为英文（W. Rhys Roberts译本）：“辨别真实与表象的劝说手段的艺术，正如辨别真实与表象的三段论是辩证法的职能一样。”
en: In encountering philological-philosophical discussions of the Greek notion of dialectics, in particular the one in use in Aristotle’s works, one often becomes bewildered. How could the practice of ‘debating’, or rather the culture of public polemical exchanges typical of the Greek

, be confused with ‘logic’ (the art of thinking worthy of the attribute philosophical, or nowadays scientific)? Yet we do not believe it is a matter of confusion but a formalization of the observed practice of dialectical exchanges through the abstraction of its rules or simply the laws of thinking accurately or in line with a consistent pursuit of truth. Thus, similarly to Marx’s treatment of the ‘concept of the atom’ – or its form – Aristotle abstracts the ideal form of what we would nowadays call logical thinking. It is as if a mould of the observed material reality is detached from its foundation and, by way of applying ‘the art’ of dialectical thinking, its image (or form) further formalized as a ‘concept’ (like Marx’s concept of the atom), very much like Wittgenstein’s Maßstab in the
The concept is the product of a ‘correct way of thinking’, as Aristotle argued in
(214a12–214a16), or the dialectical or syllogistic way of thinking discussed below through a close reading of passages from Aristotle’s

or in English (W. Rhys Roberts’ translation): ‘art to discern the real and the apparent means of persuasion, just as it is the function of dialectic to discern the real and the apparent syllogism’.

zh: 亚里士多德所指的辩证法，涉及“三段论”思维的纯粹形式，可普遍适用于任何主题。如前所述，这是一种元科学，他实际上将其称为一种能够引导人得出真实结论的思维“艺术”（技艺或技能——technē）。若剥离对真理的追求，它仅仅是修辞学；而使其具有辩证性并适于服务于正当科学探索的，正是其伦理关切——即对真实阐释周围现实事物的兴趣。
en: Dialectics, as used in Aristotle, concerns the pure form of ‘syllogical’ thinking, universally applicable to any subject matter. As already said, it is a meta-science that he in fact calls ‘art’ (craft or skill –

) of thinking that can lead one to truthful conclusions. Emptied of the pursuit of truth, it will remain rhetoric, whereas what makes it dialectical and apt to serve proper scientific exploration would be its ethical concern – the interest in truthfully explaining matters of surrounding reality.

zh: 因此，存在这三种实现说服的手段。显然，要掌握这些手段的人必须能够（1）进行逻辑推理［原文：λαβεῖν τοῦ συλλογίσασθαι δυναμένου；换言之——通过三段论的方式］，（2）理解人类品性与善的各种形式，以及（3）理解情感——即能够命名和描述它们，了解其成因以及被激发的方式。由此可见，修辞学既是辩证法的分支，也是伦理学研究的延伸。伦理学研究完全可以被称为政治学；正因如此，修辞学常伪装成政治学，其教授者也常自诩为政治专家——有时是因为缺乏教育，有时是为了炫耀，有时则源于其他人性弱点。事实上，正如我们开篇所言，它属于辩证法的一个分支，并与之相似。无论是修辞学还是辩证法，都不是对任何单一独立主题的科学研究：二者都是提供论据的能力。（亚里士多德，《修辞学》1:2）
en: There are, then, these three means of effecting persuasion. The man who is to be in command of them must, it is clear, be able (1) to reason logically [in the original: λαβεῖν τοῦ συλλογίσασθαι δυναμένου; or, in other words – by way of syllogism], (2) to understand human character and goodness in their various forms, and (3) to understand the emotions – that is, to name them and describe them, to know their causes and the way in which they are excited. It thus appears that rhetoric is an offshoot of dialectic and also of ethical studies. Ethical studies may fairly be called political; and for this reason rhetoric masquerades as political science, and the professors of it as political experts – sometimes from want of education, sometimes from ostentation, sometimes owing to other human failings. As a matter of fact, it is a branch of dialectic and similar to it, as we said at the outset. Neither rhetoric nor dialectic is the scientific study of any one separate subject: both are faculties for providing arguments. (Aristotle,

zh: 伦理投入的存在——或其缺失——不仅影响三段论的内容和论证艺术本身，也影响其形式，这使得修辞学成为一种逊于辩证法的艺术，孕育出诡辩家而非哲学家：
en: The presence of ethical investment – or the lack of it – affects not only the content of a syllogism and of the art of argumentation itself but also its form, rendering rhetoric an art inferior to that of dialectics, producing sophists instead of philosophers:

zh: 因此，很明显，修辞学并不局限于某一特定类别的主题，而是像辩证法一样具有普遍性；同样明显的是，它具有实用价值。此外，很明显，它的功能不仅仅在于成功地说服他人，而在于探索在每个具体案例的条件下，尽可能接近这种成功的方法。在这方面，它与所有其他艺术相似。例如，医学的功能并非仅仅是使人完全健康，而是尽可能地将人引向健康的道路；即便是那些永远无法享有强健体魄的人，也完全可能获得极佳的治疗。此外，很明显，辨别真实的和表象的说服手段，正是同一门艺术的功能，正如辨别真实的三段论和表象的三段论，正是辩证法的功能。使一个人成为“诡辩家”的不是他的能力，而是他的道德目的。然而，在修辞学中，“修辞家”一词既可以指演讲者对这门艺术的掌握，也可以指他的道德目的。在辩证法中则不同：一个人之所以是“诡辩家”，是因为他怀有某种道德目的，而称他为“辩证家”，依据的不是他的道德目的，而是他的能力。（亚里士多德，《修辞学》1:1）
en: It is clear, then, that rhetoric is not bound up with a single definite class of subjects, but is as universal as dialectic; it is clear, also, that it is useful. It is clear, further, that its function is not simply to succeed in persuading, but rather to discover the means of coming as near such success as the circumstances of each particular case allow. In this it resembles all other arts. For example, it is not the function of medicine simply to make a man quite healthy, but to put him as far as may be on the road to health; it is possible to give excellent treatment even to those who can never enjoy sound health. Furthermore, it is plain that it is the function of one and the same art to discern the real and the apparent means of persuasion, just as it is the function of dialectic to discern the real and the apparent syllogism. What makes a man a ‘sophist’ is not his faculty, but his moral purpose. In rhetoric, however, the term

may describe either the speaker’s knowledge of the art, or his moral purpose. In dialectic it is different: a man is a ‘sophist’ because he has a certain kind of moral purpose, a ‘dialectician’ in respect, not of his moral purpose, but of his faculty. (Aristotle,

zh: 亚里士多德开创了抽象的技艺及其过程的形式化——例如三段论，后来演变为算法——将其作为一种纯粹且在语义上空洞的思维形式的实践。他开创了算法思维的技艺。无论是他对抽象（或形式）的运用，还是他的辩证法，都属于技艺（technē）的范畴，而非本体论——外部现实无需具有辩证性或“三段论”性质，但我们对其的推理必须如此，正如算法无需反映外部现实的任何本质，却依然能够传达并模仿它。形式思维的发明，以及逻辑和对思维的算法规训，都是从物质和具体中提炼出来的实践产物。这一认识历经数千年才被重新发现并阐明，首先是由马克思（他在《经济学手稿》中捍卫了“具体”的思维，下文将讨论），随后是索绪尔，他在《普通语言学教程》中感叹道：

of algorithmic thinking. Both his use of abstraction (or form) and his dialectics are a matter of

, not of ontology – the outside reality does not need to be dialectical or ‘syllogical’, but our reasoning of it must be, just as an algorithm does not need to reflect any nature of outside reality but can nonetheless convey it and mime it too. The invention of formal thinking and of logic and algorithmic disciplining of thought is the product of a practice extracted from the material and the concrete. zh: 我们第一次摆脱了抽象。现在，我们第一次找到了占据特定位置、并与口语链中某个转折点相对应的具体、不可还原的单位：p 只不过是一个抽象单位，它连接了p>和p< 的共同特征，而p> 和p< 才是唯一实际存在的单位。同样，“唇音性”这一更高级的抽象概念将P、M 和B 联系起来。我们可以将P 视为一种动物学物种；该物种有雄性和雌性代表，但并不存在理想标本。此前，我们一直在筛选和分类这些抽象概念；但我们必须超越抽象，才能抵达具体。音系学犯了一个重大错误，即在未更仔细考察“单位”定义的情况下，便将抽象概念视为真实的单位。（1959, 53）
en: For the first time we have broken away from abstraction. Now for the first time we have found the concrete, irreducible units that occupy a place and correspond to a bent in the spoken chain: p was nothing except an abstract unit linking the common characters of p> and p<, the only units that actually exist. In the same way, the still higher abstraction of ‘labiality’ links together P, M and B. We may speak of P as if it were a zoological species; there are male and female representatives of the species, but there is no ideal specimen. Before, we had been singling out and classifying the abstractions; but we had to go beyond the abstract to reach the concrete. Phonology made a great mistake in considering abstractions real units without examining more carefully the definition of the unit. (1959, 53)

zh: 索绪尔不仅证明了任何形式化的分析程序——即通向科学真理的道路——都必须从物质出发，还证明了物质是具体的，且不应将抽象概念误认为独立存在的现实。这既是对物质性的辩护，也是对作为科学考察的（物质）实践的抽象的辩护，最终更是对科学思维中必然存在的机械论程序主义的辩护。然而，这也揭示了所有有机性——在此指语言——的机械论方面。马克思对真正唯物主义探究的本质及其政治经济学方法的阐释与此非常相似：
en: Saussure demonstrates not only that any formal procedure of analysis, which is the path to scientific truth, must depart from the material but also that the material is concrete and that the abstracted concepts ought not to be mistaken for self-standing realities. This is a vindication of materiality, of abstraction as the (material) practice of scientific examination, and, finally, of the necessarily mechanistic proceduralism of scientific thought. However, it also discloses the mechanistic aspect of all organicity – in this case, language. Marx’s explanation of the nature of true materialist inquiry and the method of his political economy is very similar:

zh: 如果我们从人口出发，这将是对整体的一种混沌表象［Vorstellung］，然后，我们将通过进一步的规定，以分析的方式向越来越简单的概念［Begriff］推进，从“想象中的具体”走向越来越细微的抽象，直到抵达最简单的规定。从那里开始，我们必须回溯这一过程，直到最终再次抵达“人口”这一概念，但这次它不再是关于整体的混乱观念，而是一个由众多规定性和关系构成的丰富总体。［……］具体之所以是具体的，是因为它是多种规定的集中，因而也是多样性的统一。（《经济学手稿》，41）
en: if we were to begin with the population, this would be a chaotic conception [Vorstellung] of the whole, and we would then, by means of further determination, move analytically towards ever more simple concepts [Begriff], from the Imagined concrete towards ever thinner abstractions until we had arrived at the simplest determinations. From there the journey would have to be retraced until we had finally arrived at the population again, but this time not as the chaotic conception of a whole, but as a rich totality of many determinations and relations. [. . .] The concrete is concrete because it is the concentration of many determinations, hence unity of the diverse. (

zh: 从手头的物质研究对象中推导出形式的机械性行为（马克思，部分源自亚里士多德），或是“根本二元组”这一最基本层面的意指行为——此处我们指的是两个能指之间的关系，这种关系并不一定需要被视为一种统一体、一对或二元对立，正如传统结构主义语言学所处理的那样——归根结底不过是单纯的物质差异，始终已经借助两个能指单位之间的物质标记（音素、书写痕迹或其他）来实现。我们在其他地方曾论述过，在“根本二元组”（这一术语借自弗朗索瓦·拉鲁埃尔

）中，两个要素之间是单向的关联，其中一方对另一方而言是“实在”与“外部性”。所谓“二者的统一”，即二元对立作为意义生成首要要素的观念，用拉鲁埃尔的话来说，不过是哲学化或哲学幻觉罢了；因为链条内部的关系实为一个单位与另一个单位之间、一与零之间的差异，而在意义实践的物质性中，它们并不以二元对立的形式存在。引用保罗·科克肖特在2020 年8 月我们私人通信中的话：“简单的二元对立甚至算不上一种关系，因为它没有顺序。它就是{＋,－}＝{－,＋}，仅仅是一个包含两个可区分符号的集合。这与{α,ω} 或{■,▫} 等并无二致。若无其他语义支撑，它们仅仅是两个可区分的标记。”尽管如此，这些机械性行为却构成了多种形式的有机性：自然语言与人工语言中的能指自动机，或者正如许煜（Yuk Hui）最近所论证的，甚至存在于自然本身之中。
en: Mechanical acts of extrapolating form from a material subject of study at hand (Marx, partly Aristotle) or the act of signification in its most basic instance of ‘a radical dyad’ – here we are referring to the relation between two signifiers, which does not necessarily need to be considered a unity, a couple or a binary, as conventional structuralist linguistics would treat it – come down to mere material differentiation, always already using a material mark (phonemes, writing traces or otherwise) between two signifying units. We have argued elsewhere that within the ‘radical dyad’, a term borrowed from François Laruelle,

the two elements are unilaterally related to one another, the one being the real and outsideness to the other. The idea of a unity of two, of a binary as the primary element of signification, is a matter of philosophization or philosophical hallucination, to paraphrase Laruelle, as the relation within a chain is differentiation between one and another unit, between one and zero, and they do not exist as a binary in the materiality of signifying practice. To quote Paul Cockshott from our private correspondence in August 2020: ‘A simple binary is not even a relation since it is unordered. It is { +,-} == {-,+}, simply a set with two distinguishable signs. No different from {α,ω} or {■,▫} etc. Without some other semantics, there are just two distinguished marks.’ Nonetheless, these acts of mechanicity amount to multiple forms of organicity: the signifying automata of natural and artificial languages, or, as Yuk Hui has argued recently, even in nature itself.

zh: 在许煜的《偶然性与递归性》一书中，后者也被视为一种指涉过程；正如许煜所论证的，正是有机生命中同样存在的递归程序，使得机械性总是在总是已经转化为有机性——二者不过是莫比乌斯带的两面，而非相互排斥的范畴。偶然性缺乏目的（telos）；它几乎毫无意义，而机械性作为机械性本身也是无意义的（它就是“管用就行”，这在本性上是偶然的）。自然借助递归来包容偶然性，正如人工智能所做的那样。据许煜所言，只有一种非目的论的目的，即生命自我维持的循环性：
en: In Hui’s

, the latter is also treated as a process of signification, and, as Hui argues, it is the procedure of recursion one also finds in organic life that enables mechanicity to always already turn into organicity, the two being mere sides of a Moebius stripe rather than mutually exclusive categories. Contingency is bereft of telos; it is almost nonsensical, and mechanicity as mechanicity is senseless too (it is ‘whatever works’, which is in its nature contingent). Nature resorts to recursion in order to include the contingent, just as AI does. According to Yuk Hui, there is only a non-teleological telos, circularity of life sustaining itself:

zh: 自然的终极目标是无法被客观观察到的。我们可以看到某棵树或某种动物，但无法通过机械规则把握自然整体。理性只能通过反思性判断来理解自然的终极目标，这意味着它会递归地抵达一个自我组织的实体。从这个意义上说，目的论思维是循环的：A→B→C→A。（Hui, 41）
en: The natural end is something that cannot be observed objectively. We can see such and such a tree or such and such an animal, but we cannot grasp nature as a whole through mechanical rules. Reason can only understand the natural end through reflective judgment, meaning that it recursively arrives at a self-organising being. Teleological thinking is in this sense circular: A→B→C→A. (Hui, 41)

zh: 机械性与唯物主义互为条件，而我们在此使用该术语的方式，与笛卡尔将身体还原为无生命的机器时所采用的用法截然不同，甚至可说是截然相反——在笛卡尔的观点中，心灵（res cogitans）是至高无上的，且在任何意义上都不属于物质领域。因此，一切看似充满生命气息的事物，皆由心灵所驱动；所有内在的、看似自发运动的物质，是由意识所驱动的；而有机体本身就是精神的。那种源自原子论和马克思、源自索绪尔、图灵和玻尔兹曼的唯物主义，本质上是一种机械论（Cockshott Turing在此指向他关于“机械性”的章节，以及关于图灵的论文）。

然而，正是物质中不可分割的最小粒子在持续的机械性碰撞中产生的运动——这与伊壁鸠鲁所说的“偏转”所引发的持续碰撞相似——能够转化为波、人类与神明所使用的语言、社会关系以及人类的生产力。一切有机的、自我调节的事物，其起源或前提皆在于粗糙物质性所具有的原始机械性。我们在本书的其他部分论证道，那些我们认为未受唯心主义哲学化影响的唯物主义形式，要么是机械论的，要么是原子论的，或者两者兼而有之：牛顿和拉格朗日，以及玻尔兹曼和马尔可夫，仅举几例。如果将机械性简化为一种低级现实——即物质性，从而容许存在一个既无法通过机械方式也无法通过有机方式（即通过“递归”整合机械默认状态下“无意义的事件”）加以解释的完整存在领域，那么我们面对的不仅是唯心主义，还是一种无法作为唯物主义主要模态发挥作用的机械性概念。很显然，我们所探讨的唯物主义并非作为形而上学基础，用于追寻万物之“始源”（有时为复数形式）。在此，某位作者在“形而上学”一词的用法上可能与本书的其他合著者有所不同。作为推动思想的前科学动力，乃至整个人类生产力的推动者——其核心在于诸如“我们为何存在于这个星球上？”“什么是善？”“为何存在‘外部世界’，而我又与之分离？”“宇宙是否有开端？”——任何形而上学问题都有相关性，且可以通过一种绕开哲学及“充分哲学原则”影响的方式加以探讨。
机械性——通常与原子论相结合，并将运动与变化提升为其第一原理——正是定义真正唯物主义的核心。正如马克思在《德意志意识形态》中论及费尔巴哈的段落及其他著作中所论述的，理性主义和哲学的埃利亚学派渊源所留下的残余——即在不变且不朽的事物中寻求原理或始原（archai）——在所有形式的唯心主义中都是不可避免的，包括受哲学影响的唯物主义。请考虑以下段落：
en: Mechanicity and materialism are conditioned upon one another, and we are using the term here quite differently from, if not in the opposite sense to, that deployed by Descartes in reducing the body to a lifeless machine, while mind –

– is superior and not of the realm of materiality in any way whatsoever. Therefore, everything that seems to breathe life is moved by Mind; all immanent, seemingly moved by and of itself, is moved by mind; and the organic is spiritual. Materialism that draws from atomism and Marx, from Saussure, Turing and Boltzmann, is mechanistic (Cockshott Turing refers to his chapter here on Mechanicity plus the paper/s on Turing).

Yet it is the movement of the uncuttable smallest particles of matter enabled by their constant mechanic encounters – similarly to the constant collisions caused by Epicurus’ swerve – that can transform itself into waves, languages spoken by humans and gods, social relations and human productivity. All that is organic and self-regulated is originated or premised on the crude mechanicity of coarse materiality. We argue elsewhere in the book that the forms of materialism we consider uncompromised by idealist philosophization are either mechanicist or they embrace atomism, or both: Newton and Lagrange, and Boltzmann and Markov, to name a few. If mechanicity is reduced to materiality as an inferior reality allowing for an entire realm of existence that is explained neither mechanically nor organically (by way of ‘recursive’ integration of ‘nonsensical occurrence’ of mechanical default), we are dealing not only with idealism but also with a notion of mechanicity that does not play the role of the primary modality of materialism. We are quite evidently not dealing with materialism as the

zh: 上述所有唯物主义者有一个共同点，即一个跨越数个世纪的共同特征：与他们所处时代绝大多数权威哲学不同，他们主张，运动并非一种“幻象”，其背后隐藏着静止的实体——即“存在”的真理，而“存在”本身是静止不变且永恒的——而是存在既显而易见又隐而不显的真理：即不断的运动与变化。
en: What all of the materialists mentioned have in common, a shared constant across centuries, is that unlike the greatest part of the authoritative philosophy of their era, they argued that movement is not an ‘apparition’ behind which a static substance resides – the truth of Being, with the Being itself unmovable and eternal – but rather that which is both the apparent and the hidden truth of existence: constant movement and change.

zh: 激进运动与历史唯物主义，而非辩证唯物主义

children: Radical movement and historical materialism rather than dialectical materialism

zh: 历史唯物主义应被视为对运动与变化的激进唯物主义理解，其思想渊源更多地源自早期原子论者，而非黑格尔。在对伊壁鸠鲁原子论的阐释中，马克思展现出黑格尔主义的影响，因为他试图通过辩证法来解决原子概念与其作为物质的具体属性之间的矛盾。我们在开篇讨论过马克思解决这一矛盾的方式，这构成了他基于伊壁鸠鲁思想遗产的唯物主义哲学的基础。据托马斯·奈尔（Thomas Nail）所言，马克思在接触黑格尔之前就开始发展他的唯物主义哲学和科学世界观，这使他为奈尔所称的“运动唯物主义（kinetic materialism）”（而非“辩证唯物主义”）奠定了基础：
en: Historical materialism should be seen as a radically materialist understanding of movement and change, more indebted to the early atomists than to Hegel. In his interpretation of Epicurean atomism, Marx displays a Hegelian influence insofar as he seeks a dialectical solution to the contradiction between the concept of the atom and the concrete properties that make it material. We discussed at the beginning the way Marx solves this contradiction, which amounts to the foundation for his materialist philosophy, building on the legacy of Epicurus. According to Thomas Nail, Marx began to develop his materialist philosophy and scientific world view prior to his exposure to Hegel, leading him to lay the foundations for what Nail calls kinetic materialism (rather than dialectical materialism):

zh: 马克思的运动理论，在其博士论文和《伊壁鸠鲁笔记》这些最早的著作中表现得最为鲜明和集中。早在阅读黑格尔之前，马克思就已经通过古代原子论展开对宗教的批判，并形成一种新的唯物主义理论。接触黑格尔之后，马克思在博士论文中同时批判了对古代原子论的反动现代主义解释和启蒙主义解释、唯物主义、唯心主义的自由理论、宗教，以及黑格尔的自然哲学。因此，马克思在博士论文中提出的运动理论和唯物主义，不仅仅是黑格尔思想的残余；这是他第一次尝试发展一种唯物主义的、以运动为基础的辩证法理论。（Nail，第20—21页）
en: Marx’s theory of motion is nowhere more evident and focused than in the earliest writings of his doctoral dissertation and Epicurean notebooks. Long before Marx had read Hegel, he had already been working out a critique of religion and a new theory of materialism through ancient atomism. After his exposure to Hegel, Marx used his dissertation to simultaneously critique the reactionary modernist and enlightenment interpretations of ancient atomism, materialism, idealist theories of freedom, religion, and the Hegelian philosophy of nature. Thus, the theory of motion and materialism put forward in Marx’s dissertation is not just a Hegelian residue; it is his first effort to develop a materialist and kinetic theory of dialectics. (Nail, 20–1)

zh: 我们赞同奈尔的观点，即马克思思想中确实存在“运动唯物主义”，且其源于伊壁鸠鲁原子论；因为正是这种原子论的运动理论——以及“偏离概念”（即“偏转”，意指运动的不完美）这一概念的提出——才为其哲学以及后来发展为科学的理论奠定了纯粹的唯物主义基础。然而，我们认为马克思采用唯物主义并非为了提供一种辩证法理论，而是恰恰相反：他运用辩证法方法——主要是由古希腊人，特别是亚里士多德所发展的方法——来构建一种以“永不停息的运动”为前提的唯物主义，或者如奈尔所称的“运动唯物主义”。如前所述，当辩证法不再仅仅是一种方法，而是同时构建一种本体论论证时，便能察觉到黑格尔的影响。例如，概念与原子的物质决定因素或属性之间的张力，被呈现为物质的，或者至少是真实的——这符合马克思主义认识论家阿尔弗雷德·索恩-雷特尔所提出的“现实抽象”概念。
“概念”确实总是已经物质化了，这是不可避免的，因为正如马克思所解释的（如上所述），如果没有物质属性，就不会有概念，然而它似乎仍被视为一种能动主体——本体论实体：
en: We concur with Nail that we can speak of kinetic materialism in Marx and that it is derived from Epicurean atomism, as it is precisely the atomist theory of movement – and the invention of the ‘declination from the concept’, or the swerve, meaning the imperfection of movement – that enables a purely materialist grounding for his philosophy and what is to become science. However, we argue that Marx did not arrive at materialism to provide a theory of dialectics but instead quite the opposite: he used the dialectical method, mainly as developed by the Greeks and Aristotle in particular, to create a materialism premised on the idea of incessant movement, or as Nail has termed it, kinetic materialism. As already noted, one can detect Hegel’s influence when dialectics is no longer only a method but also builds an ontological argument. For example, the tension between the concept and the material determinants or properties of the atom is presented as material, or at least real, in the sense of the notion of ‘real abstraction’ developed by the Marxist epistemologist Alfred Sohn-Rethel.

The ‘concept’ is indeed always already materialized, inescapably so, since, as Marx explains (as discussed above), there would be no concept without the material properties, and it nonetheless seems to be treated as an active agency – ontological entity:

zh: 存在与本质之间、物质与形式之间的矛盾——这种矛盾内在于原子概念之中——一旦原子被赋予了属性，便在单个原子本身中显现出来。通过这种属性，原子与其概念相异化，但同时在其构造上得以完善。正是源于排斥以及随之而来的具有属性的原子的聚合，现象世界才得以产生。
en: The contradiction between existence and essence, between matter and form, which is inherent in the concept of the atom, emerges in the individual atom itself once it is endowed with qualities. Through the quality the atom is alienated from its concept, but at the same time is perfected in its construction. It is from repulsion and the ensuing conglomerations of the qualified atoms that the world of appearance now emerges.

zh: 马克思和伊壁鸠鲁并不设想彼此独立的、相互分离的领域。这种矛盾是物质性的，其辩证解决并非消除矛盾；矛盾是永恒的，正是它使物质现实处于不断的运动之中。原子是“不可见的”，但它的运动及其它属性——例如重力——却造就了可见世界（或呈现在我们眼前的世界），即一种无时无刻不在运动、无时无刻不在变化的存在现象。在马克思的诠释中，他与欧洲哲学的主流及其固有的唯心主义分道扬镳，因为他并未将可见世界贬低为虚假、幻象和错觉的领域——它与不可见世界一样“真实”。恰恰相反，“不可见的原子”只有通过其现象形式（包括运动在内的各种属性）才能得以实现。真正的唯物主义者既肯定现象世界的现实性，又将其视为通向不可见世界的出发点——两者在现实性和真实性上并无高低之分：
en: Marx and Epicurus do not postulate separate realms that are independent from one another. The contradiction is material, and its dialectical solution is not a resolution; the contradiction is perpetual, and it is what maintains material reality in constant movement. The atom is ‘invisible’, yet its movement and other properties, such as

, enable the visible world (or the one that appears to us), the phenomenon of an all-moving and all-changing existence. In his interpretation, Marx parts ways with the greater share of European philosophy and its inherent idealism, as he does not relegate the visible world to a realm of falsities, apparitions and hallucinations – it is ‘no less true’ than the invisible one. Quite to the contrary, ‘the invisible atoms are realised’ only through their phenomenal form (the properties that include movement). A true materialist affirms the reality of the phenomenal world and also treats it as the departure point for accessing the invisible one – the one is no less real or true than the other:

zh: 其中一位［德谟克利特］是怀疑论者，另一位［伊壁鸠鲁］是教条主义者；前者将感性世界视为主观幻象，后者则视为客观表象。将感性世界视为主观幻象的人，致力于经验自然科学和实证知识，体现出无处不在的观察、实验和学习的热忱，足迹遍布广阔无垠的世界。而那位将现象世界视为真实的哲学家，则鄙视经验主义；他身上体现了自足而安宁的思想，以及那种从内在原则（ex principio interno）汲取知识的自给自足。但这种矛盾还远不止于此。那位将感性自然视为主观幻象的怀疑论者和经验论者，是从必然性的角度来审视它，并致力于解释和理解事物的真实存在。另一方面，那位将现象视为真实的哲学家和教条主义者，则处处只看到偶然性，而他的解释方法，反而倾向于否定自然界的一切客观现实。这些矛盾似乎蕴含着某种荒谬性。
en: The one [Democritus] is a sceptic, the other [Epicurus] a dogmatist; the one considers the sensuous world as subjective semblance, the other as objective appearance. He who considers the sensuous world as subjective semblance applies himself to empirical natural science and to positive knowledge, and represents the unrest of observation, experimenting, learning everywhere, ranging over the wide, wide world. The other, who considers the phenomenal world to be real, scorns empiricism; embodied in him are the serenity of thought satisfied in itself, the self-sufficiency that draws its knowledge

. But the contradiction goes still farther. The sceptic and empiricist, who holds sensuous nature to be subjective semblance, considers it from the point of view of necessity and endeavours to explain and to understand the real existence of things. The philosopher and dogmatist, on the other hand, who considers appearance to be real, sees everywhere only chance, and his method of explanation tends rather to negate all objective reality of nature. There seems to be a certain absurdity in these contradictions.

zh: 怀疑论以及任何形式的主观唯心主义——我们在此将后结构主义对“实在的彻底封闭”的理解也包括在内——都建立在这样一种预期之上：即人类思想能够完全接触到实在，甚至与之融合，这相当于将真理等同于实在（反之亦然）。拉鲁埃尔认为，这正是构成所有哲学的根本谬误之处。
在《哲学与非哲学》（［1989］；2013）的开篇几页中，拉鲁埃尔将上述谬误称为“实在与思想的两义混淆”
，其最典型的原则正是所有欧洲哲学的原则——即“存在”（to on，τὸὄν）作为真理与实在的统一体这一观念——也被称为“充分哲学原则”（PSP）。

马克思推崇伊壁鸠鲁，因为他没有落入拉鲁埃尔所指认的、具有自我挫败性、自相吞噬的哲学基础——即不将“表象”世界视为欺骗性的现象，而是肯定其物质性正是（原子）不可见基础的唯一蓝图，或许也是其实现的必然性。可见世界的“幻象”或“欺骗性现象”（正如巴门尼德、柏拉图、贝克莱、黑格尔、朱迪斯·巴特勒以及所有哲学家——至少根据我们在此认同的拉鲁埃尔和马克思的分析——所论证的那样）的“显现”或“欺骗性现象”，正是马克思所写的“感性世界”，也是真正的唯物主义科学——或者我们补充说，是摆脱了“PSP”的哲学——应当立足的唯一基础。“客观表象”是“自身之为自身”的实在的一个实例；它与社会关系或价值观一样客观，正如阿尔弗雷德·索恩-雷特尔在唯物主义认识论细节中阐述的那样，并以“现实抽象”的概念为例。

在该段结尾，马克思得出结论：支撑伊壁鸠鲁哲学的矛盾中存在着一种荒谬性。这些矛盾是可以解释的，但正如马克思在其关于费尔巴哈、德国意识形态及其预期的著作中所阐明的，其根源在于所有哲学中潜藏的狡猾的唯心主义。如前所述，形式或概念与原子的属性——或者简而言之，一切事物的无形物质基础和“始原”（ἀρχή）的属性——构成了辩证的连续性，这种辩证法表现为偶然者（底本作 continent）或“偶然”的永恒递归，而非等同于超越和黑格尔式辩证法理解的扬弃（das Aufgehobene）。
en: Scepticism and any variant of subjective idealism – we would include here the poststructuralist understanding of the ‘Real’s radical foreclosure’ – are predicated on the expectation that human thought has full access to, if not fusion with, the real, amounting to the equation truth = real (and vice versa). This, according to Laruelle, is what constitutes the grounding fallacy of all philosophy.
In the opening pages of
([1989]; 2013), Laruelle terms said fallacy the amphibology of real and thought
whose principle
is the principle of all European philosophy – the idea of
or tò ón (τὸ ὄν) as the unity of truth and reality – also termed as the principle of sufficient philosophy (PSP).

Marx admires Epicurus for not falling into the trap of the same principle that Laruelle identifies as the self-defeating, autophagist foundation of philosophy – dismissing the world of ‘appearances’ as phenomena deceiving instead of affirming that its materiality is the only blueprint of the invisible foundation (of the atoms) and perhaps also the necessity of their realization. The ‘apparition’ or the ‘deceiving phenomena’ of the visible world (as Parmenides, Plato, Berkeley, Hegel, Judith Butler and, in one way or another, all philosophy has argued, at least as per the analysis of Laruelle and Marx we subscribe to here) are the ‘sensuous world’ Marx writes about as the only foundation a true materialist science – or a philosophy rid of the PSP, we would add – should ground itself in. ‘Objective appearance’ is an instance of the real in and of itself; it is as objective as social relations or values, as elaborated in materialist epistemological detail by Alfred Sohn-Rethel, exemplified in the notion of ‘real abstraction’.

At the end of the paragraph, Marx concludes that there is an absurdity in the contradictions underpinning Epicurus’ philosophy. These contradictions can be explained, but through the insidious idealism in all philosophy, as Marx explains in his writings on Feuerbach and the German ideology and its expectations. As already noted, form or concept and the atom’s properties – or simply the properties of the invisible material foundation and

(ἀρχή ) of everything – constitute a dialectical continuity, a dialectics that works as a perpetual recursion of the continent or ‘chance’ rather than a sublimation (das Aufgehobene) amounting to transcendence and the Hegelian understanding of dialectics.
body.review: 英文底本末句作continent，按语境疑为contingent（偶然者），中文加括注注明底本用词。底本以sublimation对应das Aufgehobene，中文按其黑格尔语境译“扬弃”；此处不是地理上的大陆或精神分析的升华。

zh: 辩证唯物主义（diamat）的基础及其矛盾

children: The foundations of Diamat and their contradictions

zh: 在马克思主义发展一个多世纪、且辩证唯物主义（或称“diamat”教条）始终占据核心地位之后

，要证明“辩证法与唯物主义”这一复合概念并非马克思主义在其原始形态——即马克思的形态——中的基石，并且马克思将辩证法与唯物主义视为两个独立范畴，二者并不必然且不可避免地构成统一体，这无疑是一项巨大挑战。他那种从抽象（实际上是一种模糊的哲学概括）出发，抵达具体，进而推导出另一种（由具体所决定的）新抽象形式的方法，既不允许方法上的混淆与模棱两可，也不允许对现实的本体论基础——即对辩证法和方法各自的本体论基础——作出主张。我们认为，这种偏离马克思初衷的奇怪迂回，其后续发展很大程度上可能源于“辩证唯物主义”（diamat）的遗产——无论是共产国际所确立的，还是列宁去世后作为苏联官方党的学说所确立的。
en: After more than a century of Marxism and the centrality of the notion of dialectical materialism (or the dogma of Diamat),

it is quite a challenge to demonstrate that the compound notion of dialectics and materialism was not the cornerstone of Marxism in its original form, that is, Marx’s form, and that he viewed dialectics and materialism as distinct categories not necessarily and unavoidably constituting a unity. His method of moving away from an abstraction, which is in fact a vague philosophical generalization, to arrive at the concrete, only to extrapolate another new form of abstraction (determined by the concrete), would not allow for a mixture and an amphibology of method, nor a claim about an ontological foundation of reality, that is, of dialectics and method, respectively. Much of what followed in this strange detour from what we argue was Marx’s original intention is probably indebted to the legacy of Diamat (dialectical materialism), both as consolidated by the Comintern and as the official party doctrine of the USSR consolidated after Lenin’s death.

zh: 在《唯物主义和经验批判主义》
中，列宁赞扬约瑟夫·狄慈根创造了“辩证唯物主义”这一概念，从而产生了一种真正的唯物主义——一种通过辩证法方法实践的，或称为唯物主义辩证法——这被视为对马克思和恩格斯原始学说的重要补充。

在列宁撰写的这部论著中，有一点非常明确——马克思并非被呈现为发展了辩证唯物主义的思想家，而是被描绘为为狄慈根发展该理论奠定基础的人。然而，列宁对“辩证唯物主义”方法的运用，并非以构建一种古典的、斯大林主义式的“辩证唯物主义”本体论为中心，而是旨在驳斥主观主义（因其本质上属于唯心主义），并捍卫马克思主义作为毫不妥协的唯物主义。“正题、反题、合题”这一三元结构，以及由此实现的唯物主义与唯心主义的调和，既非列宁关注的焦点，也非他在这部著作中所追求的目标：
en: In

Lenin praises Joseph Dietzgen for coining the notion of ‘dialectical materialism’, thus having produced a proper materialism, one practiced by way of the method of dialectics, or as materialist dialectics, to be considered as an important addition to Marx’s and Engel’s original doctrine.

In this treatise penned by Lenin, we see one thing very clearly – Marx is not presented as the thinker who developed dialectical materialism but rather as the one who offered grounds for it to be developed by Dietzgen. However, Lenin’s use of the method of ‘dialectical materialism’ is not centred on constituting an ontology of the classical, Stalinist Diamat type but rather serves to refute subjectivism as inherently idealist and proffer a defense of Marxism as uncompromising materialism. The triad of thesis, antithesis and synthesis, and thus the reconciliation of materialism and idealism, is neither Lenin’s object of interest nor his objective in the title at issue:

zh: 贯穿所有马赫主义者所有著作的一条红线，就是他们那种愚蠢的论调，声称自己已经“超越”了唯物主义和唯心主义，已经超越了这种“过时”的对立；但事实上，这整个团体正在不断滑向唯心主义，并且对唯物主义进行着持续不断的斗争。
en: A red thread that runs through all the writings of all the Machists is the stupid claim to have ‘risen above’ materialism and idealism, to have transcended this ‘obsolete’ antithesis; but in fact this whole fraternity is continually sliding into idealism and it conducts a steady and incessant struggle against materialism.

zh: 列宁的《唯物主义和经验批判主义》首先是一部对唯物主义的坚定捍卫之作，而很难说——即使勉强可以这样说——是对当时仍属新概念的“辩证唯物主义”的捍卫，因为马克思及其亲密圈子从未真正接受过这一概念。
en: Lenin’s

is first and foremost a stark defense of materialism, and it is hardly – if at all – a defense of the notion, then still novel, called ‘dialectical materialism’, which was never really accepted by Marx and his immediate circle.

zh: 埃瓦尔德·伊连科夫对马克思和列宁著作的解读证明，马克思——以及列宁——唯物主义的核心在于构建一种知识型（episteme），它既允许以具体为出发点进行思考，又构成了客观性思想的基础。
en: Evald Ilyenkov’s reading of both Marx and Lenin proves that the kernel of Marx’s – and, for that matter, Lenin’s – materialism is the creation of an episteme allowing for thinking in terms of the concrete and constituting thought of objectivity.

zh: 马克思对“具体”的定义中最重要的一点在于：具体首先被视为事物的客观特征，这一特征完全独立于认知主体可能发生的任何演变。［……］具体性并非在主体反映对象的过程中产生的，无论是在感性阶段还是在理性—逻辑阶段。换言之，“具体”首先与唯物辩证法的任何其他范畴——如“必然”与“偶然”、“本质”与“现象”——同属一类客观范畴。它表达了自然、社会和思维的一种普遍发展形式。在马克思的理论体系中，“具体”绝非感性给定、可直接观照之物的同义词。
en: The most important aspect of Marx’s definition of the concrete is that the concrete is treated first of all as an objective characteristic of a thing considered quite independently from any evolutions that may take place in the cognising subject. [. . .] Concreteness is not created in the process of reflection of the object by the subject either at the sensual stage of reflection or at the rational-logical one. In other words, ‘the concrete’ is first of all the same kind of objective category as any other category of materialist dialectics, as ‘the necessary’ and ‘the accidental’, ‘essence, and ‘appearance’. It expresses a universal form of development of nature, society, and thinking. In the system of Marx’s views, ‘the concrete’ is by no means a synonym for the sensually given, immediately contemplated.

zh: 因此，在伊连科夫那里，“具体”是一种概念化形式，它由物质所决定并客观地塑造，是通过按照马克思的方法采取第三方的视角来实现的，而其“归根到底的同一性”
可以是一种“抽象”，类似于索恩-雷特尔的“现实抽象”概念（如上所述）。换言之，用拉鲁埃尔的术语来说，其物质可以具有先验的性质，类似于拉鲁埃尔所说的先验或哲学上的“物质”
，而其效应则是真实的。这些效应不仅是真实的，而且还由一组物质决定因素所支撑，这些因素奠定了意义结构的基础，这类似于维特根斯坦所说的Maßstab，即英语中的尺度（“实在的尺度”）
，或者类似于拉鲁埃尔在《非马克思主义导论》中提出的“实在的句法”概念。
这就是伊连科夫在上述引文中提到的那种辩证法，其中认知与被认知的具体对象之间的鸿沟保持着生产性矛盾的地位，并蕴含着一种扬弃的运动——这种运动应按照马克思博士论文中的理解来理解，而不是将矛盾实例（通过统一）进行救赎式的调和。换言之，具体事物应当保持其具体性，而非经历自我超越，最终升华为某种形式的理想性——即使这种理想性被包装成唯物主义，例如狄慈根的综合理论中所呈现的那样。
伊连科夫的以下段落进一步印证了上述比较性解读：
en: In Ilyenkov, concrete is, therefore, a form of conceptualization, one determined by the material and shaped objectively, which is achieved through assuming a third party’s perspective as per Marx’s method, while its ‘identity of the last instance’

can be an ‘abstraction’, akin to Sohn-Rethel’s notion of real abstraction (discussed above). Put differently, in Laruellian terms, its material can be of transcendental nature, similar to the notion of Laruelle’s transcendental or philosophical ‘material’,

whereas its effects are real. Not only are they real, they are also underpinned by a compound of material determinants grounding a structure of meaning similar to what Wittgenstein would call Maßstab, or, in English, scale (‘of the real’),
or to the notion of ‘syntax of the real’ as developed by Laruelle in

This is the type of dialectics Ilyenkov refers to in the passage cited above, whereby the gap between cognition and the concrete object of cognizing retains its status of a productive contradiction and implies a movement of sublation understood as it is in Marx’s doctoral dissertation rather than as a redeeming reconciliation (through unity) of contradicting instances. In other words, the concrete ought to remain concrete instead of undergoing self-transcendence culminating in some form of ideality, even if presented as materialist, such as in Dietzgen’s synthesis.
The following passage from Ilyenkov offers further corroboration of the comparative interpretation just presented:

zh: 这种对“抽象”一词的用法绝非马克思的术语任性：它与马克思逻辑观点的本质密切相关，与对思维形式与客观现实形式之间关系的辩证诠释相关，也与将实践（涉及客体的感性活动）视为思维抽象真理标准的观点相关。更不能将这种用法解释为“倒退回黑格尔主义”：马克思的论断正是针对黑格尔提出的，即在“最简单的经济范畴，例如交换价值……只能作为已经存在的具体有机整体的一种抽象的、单方面的关系而存在”。
en: This use of the term ‘abstract’ is not a terminological whim of Marx’s at all: it is linked with the very essence of his logical views, with the dialectical interpretation of the relation of forms of thinking and those of objective reality, with the view of practice (sensual activity involving objects) as a criterion of the truth of the abstractions of thought. Still less can this usage be explained as ‘a throwback to Hegelianism’: it is against Hegel that Marx’s proposition is directed to the effect that ‘the simplest economic category, eg exchange value . . . cannot exist except as an abstract, unilateral relation of an already existing concrete organic whole’.

zh: 唯物主义者所思考的范畴，根据定义且不可避免地是“抽象”的，但这种抽象既不能取代现实，现实与作为抽象（根据定义）的思想，也不构成现实与真理的统一体——即对“存在”（无论是物质的还是理想的）的哲学实现或实际化。正如伊连科夫和列宁

所阐明的，具体性并非感性的，而是概念性的。另一方面，抽象性并非理想的，而是人类认知的产物，一种先验层面的实体，它能够相对于具体性——以及通过具体性相对于现实——被单方面定位，因为具体性最接近上文提到的“现实尺度”。在伊连科夫的分析中，我们可以看到这种单边二元性在起作用，这与我们在马克思本人的著作中——更具体地说，是在他的博士论文中——所指出的，以及我们在上文讨论的拉鲁埃尔的方法中观察到的，是同一种二元性。
en: The categories in which materialists think are, by definition and unavoidably, ‘abstract’, but that abstraction is neither substituted for the real nor do they, the real and thought insofar as abstraction (by definition), constitute a unity of reality and truth – a philosophical realization or actualization of the Being, be it material or ideal. The concrete is not sensual, as both Ilyenkov and Lenin

explain, but conceptual. On the other hand, the abstract is not ideal but rather a human product of cognition, an entity of the transcendental order which can be unilaterally positioned vis-à-vis the concrete, and through it the real as the concrete is the closest to the ‘scale of reality’ mentioned above. In Ilyenkov’s analysis, we can see the unilateral duality at work, which is the same one we already noted in Marx’s own writings, his dissertation more specifically, as we did in Laruelle’s method too, discussed above.

zh: 总而言之，我们想指出这样一个事实：在后结构主义知识范式崛起的时代，我们目睹了正是索恩-雷特尔（伊连科夫亦然）曾试图推翻的逻辑仍在延续：无需讨论具体作者，我们完全可以断言，体力劳动（物质的）与脑力劳动（非物质的）之间的旧有划分不仅得以强化，而且后者在解放潜力方面的优越性这一隐含观点也随之强化。我们指的是阿尔贝托·托斯卡诺（Alberto Toscano）在论文《现实抽象的公开秘密》中讨论的索恩-雷特尔的接受史，该文主要聚焦于保罗·维尔诺（Paolo Virno）和洛伦佐·西利亚里奥（Lorenzo Cillario）。
“一般智力”似乎正在超越资本主义的价值形式，而实践则因将具体性还原为感性、物理和感官层面而被摒弃，这犯了伊连科夫所警告的谬误，如上所述。索恩-雷特尔的研究项目与伊连科夫的类似，其目标是准确解读马克思理论体系的认识论基础，并在此基础上进行富有成效的拓展。在托斯卡诺引用的致阿多诺的一封信中，索恩-雷特尔写道：
en: In conclusion, we would like to point out to the fact that, in the era of the rise of the poststructuralist episteme, we witness a perpetuation of the very logic that Sohn-Rethel (and similarly, Ilyenkov too) sought to defeat: without discussing individual authors, we can safely argue that the old division between manual (the physical) and intellectual (immaterial) labour was reinforced, as well as the implication of the superiority of the latter in terms of its emancipatory potential. We are referring to the reception of Sohn-Rethel discussed in Alberto Toscano’s paper,

children: The Open Secret of the Real Abstraction

en: , focusing mainly on Paolo Virno and Lorenzo Cillario.

‘General intellect’ seems to be transcending the value form of capitalism, whereas praxis is dismissed by reducing the concrete to the sensuous, physical and sensory, committing the fallacy Ilyenkov warns against, as presented above. The objective of Sohn-Rethel’s project, similarly to Ilyenkov’s, was to convey an accurate reading, and, based on that, a productive expansion, of the epistemological foundation of Marx’s project. In a letter to Adorno, cited by Toscano, Sohn-Rethel writes:

zh: 逻辑的拜物教概念与价值的拜物教概念在社会指涉上有所不同。后者指向资本与劳动之间的对立，前者则指向脑力劳动与体力劳动之间的对立。
en: ‘fetish-concept of logic has a different social referent with regard to the fetish-concept of value. The latter refers to the antagonism between capital and labor, the former to the antithesis between intellectual and manual labor.

zh: 正如索恩-雷特尔所言，二者是在发生学意义上相互关联的

，而在如此论证时，他始终保持着对马克思的正统忠诚：交换价值形式被确认为一种抽象，尽管将其视为一种决定性的现实（例如，类似于“社会关系”的概念）。所说的这种抽象并非通过任何形式的（一般）“智力”被客体化或实现而成为现实。这种推理将暗示物化谬误。使用价值与剩余价值之间的辩证关系是资本主义的核心；它决定了雇佣劳动作为商品化的存在。事实上，它决定了每一件商品，而其自我加速的逻辑（M–M′ 取代了M–C–M）表明，它最终将演变为超越商品或任何物质形式的纯粹价值交换（想想投机经济）。
这便是资本主义宇宙最终层面的决定性因素。经济生产正是以此方式决定着社会中的万事万物——它是社会关系宇宙中跳动的心脏，在从艺术、科学到亲属关系与亲密关系的组织等所有形式中，不断再现着同一套主体化模式。
en: The two are connected in a ‘genetic’ sense, as Sohn-Rethel puts it,

and in arguing so, he retains orthodox fidelity to Marx: the exchange value form is affirmed as abstraction, albeit treating it as a determining reality (akin to the notion of ‘social relations’, for example). The abstraction in question does not become real through any kind of (general) ‘Intellect’ being objectified or realized. Such reasoning would imply the fallacy of reification. The dialectics between use and surplus value is at the core of capitalism; it determines wage labour as commodified. It determines every commodity for that matter, and its very logic of auto-acceleration (M-M’ superceding M-C-M) demonstrates that it culminates in the exchange of pure value that transcends commodity or anything material (think of speculative economy).

This would be the determination of the last instance of capitalist universe. zh: 出自马克思博士论文关于矛盾、形式的对象化和关系的对象化的论述：“原子通过性质获得了一种与其概念相矛盾的存在；它被设定为不同于自身本质的、外化了的存在。伊壁鸠鲁主要关心的正是这一矛盾。因此，他一旦设定一种属性，从而得出原子的物质本性的后果，就同时与之相对地设定一些规定，这些规定又在该属性自身范围内破坏它，转而使原子的概念得到确认。因此，他以使各种属性自相矛盾的方式规定它们。相反，德谟克利特从不联系原子本身来考察属性，也不把其中固有的概念与存在之间的矛盾对象化。”引自卡尔·马克思：《德谟克利特的自然哲学和伊壁鸠鲁的自然哲学的差别》，《马克思恩格斯全集》英文版第1卷（Progress Publishers，1975），无页码，引自Karl Marx Internet Archive，
en: From Marx’s dissertation on contradiction, objectification of form and objectification of relation: ‘Through the qualities the atom acquires an existence which contradicts its concept; it is assumed as an externalised being different from its essence. It is this contradiction which mainly interests Epicurus. Hence, as soon as he posits a property and thus draws the consequence of the material nature of the atom, he counterposits at the same time determinations which again destroy this property in its own sphere and validate instead the concept of the atom. He therefore determines all properties in such a way that they contradict themselves. Democritus, on the other hand, nowhere considers the properties in relation to the atom itself, nor does he objectify the contradiction between concept and existence which is inherent in them’.
